page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor supports AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512_VNNI instruction sets, which assist in vector and neural network calculations. In testing, the instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1244.0 and a multi-core score of 4795.0. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 426.41 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 49.31 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. However, database operations show some constraints, with Redis SET operations performing in the lower tier at 7.45 million operations per second.

With a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and no local storage, this instance relies on network-attached storage for data persistence. It is suited for workloads requiring high clock-speed CPU performance but moderate memory footprints, such as static web serving, software compilation, and light text or image processing. It can handle small-scale language model inference, processing 518.12 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model, though performance drops significantly on larger models.
